name: bs-supervisor-proxy-set
description: Set or disable the device HTTP proxy and bypass list on a BrightSign supervisor and report the state before and after.

configDefinition.name: action
configDefinition.description: enable — configure the proxy from the values below; disable — clear it

configDefinition.name: uri
configDefinition.description: Proxy host or IP, e.g. 192.168.1.22 (required when action=enable)

configDefinition.name: username
configDefinition.description: Proxy username, leave empty for an unauthenticated proxy

configDefinition.name: password
configDefinition.description: Proxy password, leave empty for an unauthenticated proxy

configDefinition.name: bypassList
configDefinition.description: Comma-separated hosts to exempt from the proxy, e.g. example.com,*.corp.example — cleared when action=disable
